blind.description: A collection of stylized glazed ceramic kitchenware and storage pots displayed on a small, low wooden pallet. The vessels include three red-orange terracotta storage jars of various sizes, an off-white ceramic pitcher with a handle, a small green glazed jug with a handle, two cream-and-brown lidded jars with knobs, and two stacked sets of shallow white bowls. Surfaces are solid, smoothly modeled, and have clean stylized materials with gentle specularity.
blind.from_above: A square wooden pallet filled with circular shapes: three terracotta jars showing open dark interiors, two brown lidded canisters with knobs, two round white bowl rims, one white pitcher handle, and one small green jug rim with a handle protruding outward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and about 2.5 feet wide across the pallet base.
